title: Disappointed fan
text: Well, I ordered the Deadpool and Venom boxes because I collect those pops and I am a fan of both of these characters.  I'm fairly disappointed with the items. Both pops are okay I guess. I've certainly seen some better ones especially with the latest Venom releases (Ghost Rider and Loki Venom-C'mon those are awesome). This one is just kind of meh, certainly not one I think separates it from the other run of the mill pops recently released. I agree with some reviews that say these should have 2 unique pops given the quality of everything else in the boxes. I would actually prefer this as the last two don't feel like $30 +plus tax worth of "thoughtfully curated boxes by fans for fans". Nah, they can and should do better than this. Not a total rip off but pretty close, 2 stars.
label: negative
